restaurant_name: Trust dental Clinic สุขสวัสดิ์
text:
Suitable for those who are not in a hurry and have plenty of free time.
Parking is free for 3 hours at Izzy Condo, after that it's 20 baht per hour (motorcycles 10 baht).

Since I recently moved to the Suk Sawat area, I decided to book an appointment here because it's close to home and I don't have to travel far.
I booked an appointment for 3:00 PM using my social security benefits.
I arrived at 2:30 PM. The staff informed me that I had to wait for 3 people.
I waited until 3:50 PM (1 hour and 20 minutes) and still hadn't been treated.
So I canceled and went home.

P.S. I gave it 2 stars because the air conditioning was cool and there was a water cooler to drink while waiting.

**The following week, I booked an appointment at a clinic near Chan Road that I used to go to before moving to the Suk Sawat area. I got an appointment for 12:30 PM.
I arrived at 12:00 PM + waited 15 minutes + had my teeth treated for 15 minutes
= 12:30 PM. I left (this was enough for me to be willing to drive back to my old clinic).
